steps.message: Done. Here's the diagnosis and fix: ## Root cause Hacker News itself truncates long URLs in the *anchor text* it returns from the API, while keeping the complete URL in the `href`: ```html https://www.example.com/a/really/lon... ``` `DialogUtils.showTextSelectionDialog()` fed this raw HTML straight into the `HtmlTextView` of `select_text_dialog.xml`, so the "select text" view rendered the same shortened text. Tapping the link still worked (the `href` is intact), but selecting/copying the text only gave the truncated `...` version — exactly what the bug report describes. ## Fix **`utils/Utils.java`** – new helper `expandTruncatedLinks(String html)`: - Finds every `text` (case-insensitive, DOTALL so multi-line link text works). - Decides whether the link text is an HN-truncated URL via `isTruncatedLinkText()`: strips any inner markup, decodes HTML entities (HN escapes slashes as `/`), requires the text to end in `...` or `…`, **and** requires the remaining prefix to actually match the start of the `href`. This guard keeps user-written anchor text such as `my own text...` untouched. - When truncated, replaces the visible text with the full `href`. The href comes from an attribute value, which is escaped the same way as text content, so it's inserted as-is (only `<`/`>` are guarded) — avoiding double-encoding of things like `&` in query strings. **`utils/DialogUtils.java`** – the select-text dialog now calls `htmlTextView.setHtml(Utils.expandTruncatedLinks(text))`. The comment list rendering is untouched, so links stay compactly truncated while reading; only the text-selection dialog shows full URLs. ## Verification - `./gradlew clean assembleDebug` → **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**. - Ran the transformation logic standalone on representative HN markup: truncated link expanded to the full URL, short (non-truncated) links unchanged, custom anchor text unchanged, link text containing nested `` markup handled, and query-string `&` preserved correctly.
